issues.description: The problem statement UML (Stock.add) declares add(String) as returning void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) to return int. This mismatch between the UML in the problem statement and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the documentation and code. Either update the UML in problem_statement.md to show add(String): int (and document the meaning of the returned int), or change the template and solution Stock.add implementation to return void. Prefer updating the problem statement UML to match the existing template/solution (add returns int) to avoid breaking provided code.
